lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters extending from the posterior branchial slits toward the caudal region, with the highest concentration in the mid-flank zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal linear features are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high-luminance highlights on the superior edge and low-luminance shadows on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance circular blobs scattered across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A high-contrast white and dark artificial object is attached at the anterior base of the first dorsal fin, with a thin, linear trailing filament extending posteriorly through the water column.
other_distinctive_markers: Several dark, elongated silhouettes with high-luminance ventral tips are attached to the ventral-lateral region of the flank, posterior to the pectoral fin.
